entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: A Master Wizard, founder of the College of Lat-Nam and the Union of the Third Path, and wife of Drafna; killed in the Fall of Terisia City.

entities.name: Drafna
entities.description: An artificer, Hurkyl's husband and fellow founder of the College of Lat-Nam.

entities.name: College of Lat-Nam
entities.description: The college Hurkyl and Drafna founded.

entities.name: Union of the Third Path
entities.description: An alliance of mages, scholars and artificers seeking neutrality in the war between Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Terisia City
entities.description: The city where the Union was founded and Hurkyl lived out her life.

entities.name: Archimandrite
entities.description: Invited the couple to Terisia City and became Hurkyl's pupil.

entities.name: Feldon
entities.description: A founder of the Union of the Third Path.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: One of the warring brothers, whose forces besieged Terisia City.

entities.name: Fall of Terisia City
entities.description: The 45 AR event in which Mishra's forces got past the gates.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra on Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane of the Brothers' War.

events.summary: Invited to Terisia City, Hurkyl joins others to establish the Union of the Third Path, seeking neutrality in the Brothers' War.
events.quote: Hurkyl joined her husband, Feldon , Chayum-Icha , Kathwar , and others to attend meetings to establish the Union of the Third Path .

events.summary: Hurkyl teaches meditation techniques to pupils including the Archimandrite.
events.quote: She taught her techniques to an increasingly growing crowd of pupils, including the Archimandrite .

events.summary: Mishra's forces breach Terisia City; Hurkyl vaporizes three dragon engines, then is killed by spearmen.
events.quote: She was killed by invading spearmen right afterwards.

relations.quote: She was the wife of Drafna
one of the founders of the College of Lat-Nam and the Union of the Third Path

relations.note: Mishra's forces besieged and invaded Terisia City.
relations.quote: when Mishra 's forces finally got past the gates of Terisia City after months of siege
